name: NRF discovery query check
description: Query NRF discovery for AMF and SMF instances and print readable JSON responses

amf_query_url.description: NRF discovery URL used to find AMF instances

smf_query_url.description: NRF discovery URL used to find SMF instances

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to establish each NRF connection

max_time_seconds.description: Maximum total time for each NRF request

curl_insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for HTTPS NRF URLs

require_registered.description: Require at least one matching NF instance with REGISTERED status
